text: Agile methodology is a popular way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses items from the backlog, a prioritised list of tasks often written as user stories. These stories describe features from the user's point of view. Every day, the team holds a short meeting called a standup to share progress and problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to adapt quickly to changes and deliver working results regularly.
